name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: B2B Growth & Performance Marketing | Paid Social, Channel Testing & AI-Driven Campaigns
summary: B2B growth marketer who runs paid channels, tests them, and makes the call on what to scale. At Level Agency I ran account-based LinkedIn campaigns with A/B-tested setups and planned budgets for accounts spending $20K+/month, some peaking above $100K. At Solenzo I build AI-driven acquisition systems and test offers end to end, from targeting to conversion tracking to CRM.

experience.title: Growth Marketing Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Launched a free digital-footprint audit as a top-of-funnel offer, distributed through LinkedIn organic growth: 180+ businesses enrolled, 2 converted to paying clients.
Optimized a client's Google Ads account to cut spam and low-quality leads, then diagnosed on-site conversion as the remaining bottleneck.
Build AI-driven acquisition workflows that score a business's digital footprint and generate personalized outreach, using LLM APIs inside n8n, Make, and Zapier.
Install Meta Pixel and Google Ads conversion tracking, enforce UTM conventions, and build funnel and ROI dashboards.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Designed and ran LinkedIn ad campaigns on an account-based model, targeting small, highly researched audiences with A/B-tested setups.
Advised clients on budget planning and allocation across ~3 accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend each, peaking above $100K/month.
Built campaign reporting tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, and presented optimization recommendations in QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Built a channel of 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94%).

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed paid media and creative performance at a performance marketing agency and closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Advised on A/B testing strategy for a Salesforce workflow effort, defining test structure and success criteria.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in B2B SaaS sales on a team of 8-15 reps while quota roughly doubled, selling to agencies and architecture and engineering firms.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
